cases.obligation: The maintained autostart plugin is configured with exactly the Engine process-mode argument.
The plugin and exact-command backend share one package-derived registration name; repeated setup preserves one Run and one StartupApproved value.
A failed plugin enable operation is returned as a registration failure after restoring the prior Run and StartupApproved values.
A stored-command mismatch is returned as a failure after restoring the prior Run and StartupApproved values.
A stored-command read error is returned as a verification failure after restoring the prior Run and StartupApproved values.
The production Windows autostart serializer quotes a spaced executable path and appends exactly the Engine mode argument.
If the exact-command rewrite fails after plugin enable, rollback removes every malformed intermediate value when no prior values existed.
Actual Windows Engine and Settings processes remain alive concurrently under one executable identity.
A concurrently running Settings process adds no content window or WebView2 descendant to the Engine process.

A second actual Settings launch exits successfully and activates one content window in the existing Settings process while Engine remains alive; the Windows receiver restores the recorded top-level HWND without cross-thread Tauri handle access.
The production Settings CloseRequested leaf requests process exit.

After deterministic Settings setup and a newly-created WebView2 descendant are observed, the explicit debug seam closes the production Tauri window, removes the Settings process and observed WebView2 process identities, and leaves Engine running.
Two concurrent cold Settings launches converge on exactly one live Settings process and at most one content window while Engine remains alive.
The launch gate remains held across a delayed Engine-unavailable setup until Ready, so concurrent cold launches still converge on one Settings process.
Repeated tray open requests spawn the current executable with exactly the Settings process-mode argument.
The Engine Quit leaf requests worker shutdown before process exit.
The production Engine Quit seam has shutdown and exit capabilities only, so it cannot mutate login autostart registration.
